q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: WITH CTE1 AS ( SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW GROUP BY FOLLOWER HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1 ) SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(*) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM CTE1) GROUP BY FOLLOWEE HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1 ORDER BY FOLLOWER
